about: Settled verdicts for the 12 contested real-bug findings (no strict majority among four judges) in m2-compare and m2-real-more. Judge votes in grades/ are unchanged; these are stored separately. source: verify = the reviewreplay verify code check; read = settled by reading the case's code, quote given.

findings.subject: baseline
findings.evidence: verify confirmed: the fp32 upcast runs before model.to(torch.device("meta")), on real CPU tensors on every rank.

findings.subject: baseline
findings.evidence: verify unsure: only requires_grad params are upcast, so frozen params keep their dtype; whether FSDP2 rejects mixed dtypes in one group needs torch's source.

Cited line 199 is 7 lines from the spot, so the ±3 gate kept it from the judge (see PR #13). Recall is unchanged: findings 1 and 2 of this review are already hits.

findings.subject: code-review-skill-invoked
findings.evidence: True and not b1: `help_escaped = help_.replace("\n", r"\n")` writes a two-character backslash-n, and the fish template prints it with plain `echo $metadata[2]\t$metadata[3]`, which does not expand it.

findings.subject: baseline
findings.evidence: It names the added lines (`push_scope(id_of(self.schema))` in __attrs_post_init__) and blames them for wrong $ref resolution, but its mechanism is a push that is never popped, while b1 is a None id being pushed. The upstream fix only skips the push when the id is None. Same defect or not is a judgement call.

findings.subject: code-review-skill-invoked

findings.subject: code-review-skill-invoked
findings.evidence: verify confirmed: Conv3d inherits _ConvNd.get_delta_weight, which checks weight.size()[2:4] == (1, 1) and squeezes dims 3 and 2.

findings.subject: code-review-skill-invoked
findings.evidence: True: lora/model.py:748 is `conv2d = isinstance(target, Conv2d)`, and Conv3d is a sibling class (layer.py:1145, `class Conv3d(_ConvNd)`), so a 5D Conv3d delta weight skips the flatten and the reshape back.
